description: Every interactive control needs visible keyboard focus
do: Use :focus-visible with sufficient contrast

description: Status must use text, icon, shape, or pattern in addition to colour
do: Pair colour with labels or icons

description: Meaningful images require useful alt text
do: Describe purpose; use empty alt for decorative

description: Icon-only controls need accessible names
do: Use aria-label or visible text

description: Respect reduced-motion preference
do: Disable or simplify non-essential motion

description: No unintended horizontal overflow
Keep long text to readable measure
do: Use max-inline-size around 55-75ch

description: Primary task or message should be evident in five seconds
do: Use scale, position and contrast intentionally

description: Cards are not a default composition system
do: Use continuous panes, rows, tables or editorial sections when appropriate
dont: Wrap every section in identical cards

description: One coherent visual direction
do: Define tokens and component conventions
dont: Mix unrelated radii, shadows and icon styles

description: Use credible content and microcopy
do: Write product-specific labels and examples
dont: Lorem ipsum and generic placeholder labels

description: Actions require immediate feedback
do: Use pressed, busy, success and error states

description: Disabled controls must look and behave disabled
do: Use native disabled semantics and explanation when needed

description: Interactive targets need adequate hit areas
do: Use approximately 44px targets for touch contexts
dont: Tiny icons with no hit area

description: Keep common motion concise
do: Use 150-300ms for common transitions

description: Motion should explain change or create one deliberate moment
do: Animate state, hierarchy or spatial movement
dont: Animate everything because it looks modern

description: Optimise images and reserve space
do: Use responsive dimensions, modern formats and lazy loading
dont: Huge unbounded images causing layout shift

description: Use fallbacks and avoid blocking the experience
do: Use system fallbacks and preload only when justified

description: Do not add heavy dependencies for one effect
do: Prefer CSS or existing libraries
dont: Install animation or UI frameworks casually

description: Fields require visible labels
do: Use label elements and helper text

description: Place actionable error messages near fields
do: Explain what happened and how to fix it
dont: Generic error at page top only

description: Do not discard input after validation failure
do: Retain values and focus first error

description: Show meaningful loading state
do: Use skeleton or progress appropriate to expected content

description: Empty states should explain and offer next action
do: Use context-specific copy and action
dont: Show an empty table with no guidance

description: Errors need recovery
do: Explain scope and provide retry or fallback

description: Users need clear location and predictable back behaviour
do: Use active state, breadcrumbs or titles as appropriate

description: Progressively disclose complexity
do: Use contextual detail and command palettes
dont: Put every feature in primary navigation

description: Headings should communicate the point
do: Write outcome or insight-led titles
dont: Generic titles such as Overview or Welcome

description: Microcopy should match brand and reduce uncertainty
do: Use specific action labels and consequences
dont: Submit, Click here, Something went wrong

description: Use one consistent icon family and style
do: Standardise size and stroke
dont: Mix emoji, filled and outline icons randomly

description: Use a coherent surface and elevation system
do: Define surface ladder and overlay elevation
dont: Every element has a different shadow

description: Gradients need a defined role
do: Use for atmosphere, hierarchy or brand fields

description: Dark mode needs independent contrast and depth tuning
do: Test text, borders, surfaces and states separately

description: Choose chart by analytical question
do: Use trend, comparison, distribution or relationship logic
dont: Add donut or gauge for decoration

description: Show source and freshness where trust matters
do: Expose timestamp, source or confidence

description: Show generated or tool-driven process when relevant
do: Expose sources, tool states and limitations

description: Navigation must transform intentionally
do: Use drawer, condensed nav or priority links
dont: Squeeze desktop nav into tiny width

description: Mobile order must reflect task priority
do: Reorder and collapse support content
